description_en: Removes a database instance from Data Management (DMS)
description_zh: 调用deleteinstance接口，在DMS中删除指定实例
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise delete-instance --tid 3000 --host xxx.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --port 3306 --sid testSid --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteInstance

parameters.description_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.
parameters.description_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。

parameters.description_en: The endpoint of the database instance. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to obtain the endpoint.
